title: Russia and Ukraine agree large prisoner swap as Abu Dhabi talks end without territory deal
caption:
Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war at the end of two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi, with the final numbers due on Thursday. There was no breakthrough on territory, which remains the main obstacle to a peace deal. US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff travel to Moscow on Thursday to meet Vladimir Putin, then plan to meet Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Dublin.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
